svg.title: Original phase-diagram reading guide with temperature and pressure axes
svg.desc: An original empty graph coordinate guide: horizontal axis temperature in kelvin K, vertical axis pressure in megapascal MPa. No phase boundaries, scale values, or region positions are plotted because the original NBF helium diagram has not been independently verified. A separate side legend lists four possible state labels: solid, normal liquid, superfluid, and gas. To identify a phase in the real graph use both temperature and pressure and a verified phase boundary source. This is not a copy, trace or reconstruction of NBF Figure 6.17.
svg.text: How to read a helium pressure–temperature phase diagram
